newsitem.title: UK: National Grid marked up on profit, cost aims.
newsitem.headline: National Grid marked up on profit, cost aims.

text.p: Shares in National Grid Plc were indicated higher in pre-market dealing on Tuesday after the British utility announced first-half profits in line with forecasts and detailed its plans to cut its core costs.
National Grid shares were marked six pence, or three percent, higher at 205p while the broader market was indicated 0.4 percent higher.

Pretax profit dropped to 292.7 million pounds in the first half from 335.5 million a year earlier. Analysts had forecast profits between 279 million pounds and 304 million. The company said it aimed to cut its core costs by six percent a year.
